title: Is oral squamous cell carcinoma arising in the background of oral submucous fibrosis a distinct entity? A systematic review and meta-analysis of clinicopathological and prognostic outcomes
html: This systematic review and meta-analysis was performed to assess and compare clinicopathological and survival outcomes in oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) arising in the background of oral submucous fibrosis (OSCC-OSMF) and OSCC without any background of OSMF (non-OSMF-OSCC). A literature search in PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science was performed up to August 2025. Studies comparing clinicopathological features between OSCC-OSMF and non-OSMF-OSCC were considered. Demographics, tumour site, stage, histopathology, nodal and other histological features, and survival data were extracted.
